tasks.short: Duplicate evidence for recovery and analysis

steps.what: Identify the authorised source evidence and prepare the duplication environment
Duplicate digital evidence using the approved forensic imaging tool
Verify the duplicate and document its source association and integrity

tasks.design: Retain authorised preparation, imaging supervision and verification using existing {OTHER} forensic tools. The tools already perform copying; their elapsed runtime is not a new reduction in analyst labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence duplication requires reliable source identification and defensible handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing imaging tools already provide technical copying and integrity records.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged sources, incomplete images and discrepancies between the intended and actual source.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst recognises when a duplicate cannot be treated as reliable.
tasks.altitude: Duplication responsibility and verification remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Trace item identifiers and integrity records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forensic imaging tools already copy evidence; source selection, handling and integrity interpretation remain analyst work.

assumptions: Boundary is creating and verifying an analysis duplicate, excluding later forensic analysis and long-term preservation.

Analyst identifies case ID, source item ID, authorised scope and destination in s1's 25 hours. Existing imaging tool produces image identifiers, integrity values and imaging log during s2; analyst verifies them in s3's 25 hours. Missing or inconsistent records cause manual resolution and no automatic verified flag is assumed.
Review native approved imaging capabilities before new code; shares represent active handling and supervision only, excluding unattended copy time.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or process is introduced.
unknowns: Frequency of damaged or incomplete sources
research_questions: Which duplication exceptions require additional source handling rather than a repeat tool run?

already_counted.description: Source preparation, active imaging work and verification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Existing copying runtime is excluded from labour and all analyst duties retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Preserve forensic evidence for later analysis

steps.what: Preserve evidence items using the required physical or logical handling procedure
Maintain controlled evidence storage and verify integrity or access concerns
Record evidence custody and resolve preservation discrepancies

tasks.design: Keep preservation and custody checks with the analyst using existing {OTHER} evidence storage and {DOCS} records. Existing access logs support the check but cannot establish that the full handling history is reliable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preservation depends on actual handling and the completeness of custody evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing storage controls already support preservation; no new validated labour-removal step is established.
tasks.still_hard: Unexplained transfers, storage anomalies and uncertainty about an item's handling history.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can challenge a gap rather than treat a complete-looking register as sufficient.

reach.learn: Distinguish observed transfers from incomplete records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forensic preservation involves controlled handling and substantive custody checks, not only storing a file.

assumptions: Boundary is ongoing preservation and custody, excluding initial duplication and substantive analysis. Physical and logical handling vary by evidence type.

Analyst observes and captures case ID, evidence ID, custody event, time, responsible person and location in the retained steps. Existing storage produces access and integrity records; missing custody evidence requires manual investigation, not an inferred preserved flag.
Use existing approved storage and custody tools before code; current runtime earns no saving.
Zero upkeep because no changed preservation process is introduced.
research_questions: Which custody gaps cannot be resolved from existing storage records alone?

already_counted.description: Preservation, integrity checks and custody handling

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. All preservation and custody effort is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply legal handling procedures to digital media

steps.what: Adhere to applicable legal policies and procedures when handling digital media

tasks.design: Keep applying legal handling boundaries with the analyst using the current procedure in {DOCS}. Unclear authority is referred to the responsible legal or case owner; software does not infer permission to handle or disclose evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Permitted handling depends on case authority and applicable rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved procedures provide a reference without delegating the legal judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising when a circumstance falls outside the documented authority.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can stop and seek clarification before exceeding the permitted scope.

reach.learn: Describe the proposed action and missing authority precisely

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: evidence-handling authority and procedures depend on jurisdiction and case circumstances and must be confirmed by the responsible local owner.

assumptions: Boundary is recognising and applying handling authority; physical copying and preservation labour belongs to the separate tasks and is allocated once.

Existing legal or case owner supplies the applicable procedure and mandate before handling. Analyst checks scope and circumstances within s1's 100 retained hours; missing authority causes manual escalation, not an automatically generated permission flag.
Use existing approved procedure access before new software; current runtime earns no saving.
Zero upkeep because no new process is introduced; national and case-specific requirements remain customer facts.
research_questions: Which recurring handling questions are not resolved by the current approved procedure?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. No authority checking or procedural judgement is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report and testify about forensic findings

steps.what: Select verified findings and evidence references for the legal report
Write the report narrative from the selected forensic findings

loop.purpose: Draft a report narrative confined to the analyst's findings
loop.input: Selected verified findings, source references, limits and the required report structure
loop.output: One draft narrative with each factual claim linked to a supplied finding
loop.check: Analyst checks every assertion against source evidence, distinguishes observation from inference and verifies that limitations and alternative explanations are not weakened or omitted
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported assertions, altered certainty or missing references return to manual writing; no signature, filing or testimony is generated as final
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates supply structure first; expressing the selected findings coherently may require prose drafting beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Verify and issue the report or sign the exact affidavit
Give depositions and explain findings and uncertainty under questioning

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} report structure first and a bounded narrative draft only from the analyst's selected verified findings. The analyst verifies the exact final text before issuing or signing and gives testimony personally; the draft has no authority to make findings or legal declarations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a coherent narrative can duplicate the expression of already completed findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can supply prose for line-by-line expert review.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving evidential uncertainty and explaining findings accurately under questioning.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst accepts responsibility for the findings and can explain their basis and limits.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass narrative writing while report responsibility and testimony remain personal.

reach.task: Clarify the scope of a forensic conclusion
reach.learn: Distinguish a finding from an inference or unresolved question

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound prose drafting can assist report writing, but factual verification, signing and testimony remain with the analyst.

assumptions: Boundary is reporting completed findings and any required testimony; substantive forensic analysis is separately counted. Affidavit and deposition shares are an aggregate case mix, not mandatory outputs for every report.

Analyst's completed investigation produces original findings as existing separate work. In s1's 35 hours the analyst captures finding IDs, source references, evidence versions, certainty, limitations and reporting scope; missing support is withheld or resolved manually. No automatically produced verified-finding flag is accepted.
Use native report templates before model drafting; existing document runtime earns no saving.
Case confidentiality, permitted model access and national declaration requirements are confirmed locally; unavailable approval means manual writing, with no automatic filing.
unknowns: Permitted model access to case material
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting reduce writing effort after counting every unsupported or overconfident statement corrected?

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report or affidavit version, findings, limitations, evidence references and recipient checked before issue or signature; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10 and net=5 after five upkeep hours. Range assumes some first-pass narrative assistance; source selection, final verification and testimony retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect evidence handling and authority checks while reducing only a small verified portion of first-draft reporting.
reach: Explain evidence provenance and conclusion limits to case owners and custodians
role.ambitious_version: A forensic analyst who can defend evidence handling and every reported conclusion with clear source references and personal accountability.
